```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(backgammonr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

This notebook stays on opening roll `1-6` and compares canonical Thompson to the other Thompson-style policies.

The comparison still runs through `bg_compare_algorithms()`. The only difference is the `methods` vector.

```{r settings}
truth_budget <- 100000L
roll_1_6_truth_path <- file.path(
  "artifacts",
  "opening_truths",
  paste0("opening_1-6_truth_budget_", truth_budget, ".rds")
)

if (!file.exists(roll_1_6_truth_path)) {
  stop("Run 01_save_all_21_opening_truths.Rmd first so the 1-6 truth file exists.")
}

variant_budgets <- c(16L, 32L, 64L, 128L, 256L, 512L)
variant_seeds <- 1:25
variant_methods <- c(
  "thompson",
  "top_two_thompson",
  "multi_sample_thompson",
  "tempered_thompson",
  "budget_aware_thompson",
  "elimination_thompson",
  "ranking_aware_thompson"
)
variant_overwrite <- FALSE

study_dir <- file.path("artifacts", "studies")
dir.create(study_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

variant_path <- file.path(
  study_dir,
  "opening_1-6_thompson_variants.rds"
)

truth_1_6 <- bg_truth_load(roll_1_6_truth_path)

problem_1_6 <- bg_problem(
  state = bg_initial_board(),
  roll = bg_roll(1L, 6L),
  simulation_policy = "random",
  reward_model = "scalar_payoff",
  posterior_model = "beta_pseudo",
  problem_id = "opening_1-6"
)
```

```{r variant-comparison}
variant_compare_1_6 <- bg_compare_algorithms(
  problems = problem_1_6,
  methods = variant_methods,
  budgets = variant_budgets,
  seeds = variant_seeds,
  proxy_references = truth_1_6$reference,
  save_path = variant_path,
  overwrite = variant_overwrite
)
```

```{r variant-eval}
variant_eval <- bg_eval_reference_aware(
  variant_compare_1_6,
  truth = truth_1_6$reference,
  top_k = 3L
)

variant_summary <- aggregate(
  variant_eval[, c(
    "top1_match",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "spearman",
    "top_k_overlap",
    "share_best_truth",
    "allocation_entropy"
  )],
  by = list(
    allocation_policy = variant_eval$allocation_policy,
    checkpoint = variant_eval$checkpoint
  ),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

variant_summary <- variant_summary[
  order(variant_summary$allocation_policy, variant_summary$checkpoint),
]

knitr::kable(
  variant_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Average performance for the Thompson-family variants on opening roll 1-6."
)
```

```{r variant-final-budget}
variant_final <- variant_eval[variant_eval$checkpoint == max(variant_budgets), ]
variant_final <- aggregate(
  variant_final[, c(
    "top1_match",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "spearman",
    "top_k_overlap",
    "share_best_truth",
    "allocation_entropy"
  )],
  by = list(allocation_policy = variant_final$allocation_policy),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  variant_final,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Average variant performance at the largest budget."
)
```

```{r variant-runtime}
variant_runtime <- aggregate(
  variant_compare_1_6$results[, c("runtime_seconds", "rollout_throughput")],
  by = list(
    allocation_policy = variant_compare_1_6$results$allocation_policy,
    checkpoint = variant_compare_1_6$results$checkpoint
  ),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  variant_runtime,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Average runtime and throughput for the Thompson-family variants."
)
```

```{r variant-regret-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_budget_curve(
  variant_compare_1_6,
  metric = "simple_regret",
  truth = truth_1_6$reference
)
```

```{r variant-match-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_budget_curve(
  variant_compare_1_6,
  metric = "top1_match",
  truth = truth_1_6$reference
)
```

```{r variant-rank-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_budget_curve(
  variant_compare_1_6,
  metric = "spearman",
  truth = truth_1_6$reference
)
```

```{r variant-allocation-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_budget_curve(
  variant_compare_1_6,
  metric = "share_top_k_truth",
  truth = truth_1_6$reference
)
```

```{r variant-runtime-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
ggplot(variant_runtime, aes(x = checkpoint, y = runtime_seconds, color = allocation_policy)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Runtime by Thompson-family variant",
    x = "Budget checkpoint",
    y = "Runtime (seconds)",
    color = "Variant"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
